description: This PHP source file appears to generate a web page for displaying linked bugs associated with test execution results in the TestLink project management system. It initializes the page, retrieves data about test plans, test projects, and bugs, and then dynamically creates an HTML table to show test cases along with their linked bug reports. It also defines helper functions for fetching bug links and table column definitions, as well as argument parsing and rights checking.

methods.name: buildBugString
methods.description: Fetches bug URLs for a specific execution using the bug interface object; updates open and resolved bugs arrays

methods.name: getColumnsDefinition
methods.description: Returns configuration for table columns: test suite name, test case title, and linked bugs

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns argument parameters from request and session

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has rights on the project
